name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in Moscow, where he spent countless hours watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, at Bauman Moscow State Technical University. After graduating, Dimitri gained valuable experience working as a data analyst for a small racing team, where he honed his skills in interpreting telemetry data and identifying areas for improvement.

He joined Rahal Letterman Lanigan as a simulator engineer, where he is responsible for developing and maintaining the team's state-of-the-art simulator. Dimitri's meticulous approach to data analysis, coupled with his innovative ideas, has made him a valuable asset to the team. He is known for his ability to translate real-world data into accurate and meaningful simulator experiences, enabling drivers to fine-tune their performance and optimize car setups. Dimitri is also a creative problem solver, always seeking new ways to improve the simulator's fidelity and provide drivers with the most realistic and effective training environment possible.

physical.description: Dimitri is of average height and build, with sharp, focused eyes and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small Rubik's Cube and solves it during breaks.
Has a particular fondness for strong black tea and drinks several cups throughout the day.
Meticulously organizes his workspace and color-codes all his data files.
